# Session 107 Plan — Wave 2: Stage-2 Verification Cohort (register-sourced, open-channel-ledger §C)

**Date**: 2026-06-13
**Author**: gen-physicist (generated by /rclab-plan per-wave swarm)
**Owner agent**: gen-physicist (authors the gate blocks + owns the dispatch-and-PASS-AND-closeout structure; the two cross-reviewers per verify are domain specialists named per gate, axis-distinct + non-author)
**Plan source**: `sessions/session-plan/session-107-context.md` §"Per-gate planning detail → 3–6" + §"Deduplicated corpus table" rows 3–6
**Working paper**: `sessions/session-107/session-107-w2-workingpaper.md`
**Verdict file**: `computations/session-107/s107_gate_verdicts.txt` (canonical per `.claude/rules/gate-verdicts.md`)

## Wave 2 Summary

Four STAGE-1-CANDIDATE joint cross-axis theorems from the `open-channel-ledger.md §C` Stage-2 cohort remain Stage-2-pending after S106 cleared K3 (§VII.AD) and K12 (§VII.BZ). This wave dispatches the four pending verifies — **K2 §VII.AC.1**, **K7 §VII.X.W4-1**, **K9 §VII.X.2-NECESSITY**, **K11 §VII.AC.4** — each as a **two-agent parallel cross-axis Stage-2 verify** per `.claude/rules/joint-theorem-promotion.md` §"Stage 2". (K8 §VII.AF.1.STATE-PROJ is PENDING-VERIFICATION and HELD — its precondition is unmet; NOT in this batch.)

These verifies compute **no new physics numbers**. Each audits the *registered Stage-1 theorem* from first principles via two reviewers on DIFFERENT axes, dispatched IN PARALLEL, BOTH operating WITHOUT prior workshop context (read only the registered §VII Stage-1 entry text + the slot's input data files — NEVER the originating workshop transcript). The PASS predicate is the **cross-axis PASS-AND**, not a `value < threshold` numerical comparison: BOTH reviewers PASS their single-axis clauses AND every JOINT clause PASSes in BOTH verdicts (logical AND). The "agreement" emerging from this protocol is structurally NOT shared-context agreement (the two cross-reviewers have never seen the workshop), which is the constructive complement to `.claude/rules/epistemic-discipline.md` §"What Does NOT Count as Evidence" item 2 (the agreement-among-agents exclusion this blind protocol sharpens).

**Wave-class (per `.claude/rules/Investigating-Workshops.md §"Q3"`)**: this cohort is a **parallel-compute-wave** (N=4 independent verifies + per-theorem PASS-AND closeout), NOT an N-agent adversarial panel. Each per-axis reviewer is a *derivation-author tag* (which agent audits which clause-set from first principles), NOT a workshop-participant/debate tag. There is no R1/R2/R3 rebuttal protocol — the two axes are structurally orthogonal, so reviewer-A cannot meaningfully rebut reviewer-B's verdict on a different axis. The orchestrator (gen-physicist) computes the AND of the two verdicts and emits exactly one verdict line per gate.

## Wave 2 Decision-Point Prerequisites

No intra-S107 upstream verdict gates this wave. The prerequisite for each gate is the **registered Stage-1 §VII entry** + its **slot input data files** (all on disk, SHAs in the §"Wave 2 Input-SHA Ledger" below). No prior wave of S107 feeds Wave 2. Each gate is independently dispatchable.

**Plan-freeze prerequisite (reviewer-exclusion)**: each gate block below pins its two named cross-reviewers AND states the registered §VII Stage-0 authorship lines (extracted from `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` + atlas-07) plus the downstream-inheritance reach test, satisfying all THREE conditions of the `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage-2 Axis-B Selection Protocol"`. This is the S99 E1 lesson (a reviewer whose memory/lineage inherits the workshop reading-path FIRES the downstream-inheritance reach test and must be re-dispatched). The `_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py` 6-item checklist (enumerated in §"Wave 2 Audit-at-Plan-Freeze Checklist" below) runs at plan-freeze against each gate block.

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator — the cross-axis PASS-AND, NOT a numerical comparison
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: >
    PASS iff ( ALL single-axis-A clauses PASS in reviewer-A verdict )

  scan_range: "N/A"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "N/A — boolean PASS-AND, no numerical tolerance"

audit_discriminators:

# (7) substitution_chain — REQUIRED: the gate makes a "binary-not-continuous" / "neither anchor alone" direction claim that the reviewers must re-derive
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Path-H and Path-C are binary-not-continuous projections of r; neither V1 nor C1 alone fixes the conclusion (SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY, not PRIMARY+CONFIRMATION)."
    Definition 1: A_F = C (+) H (+) M_3(C)  [registered entry; Wedderburn semisimple finite fiber]
    Definition 2: V1 = 3He-B BDI 0D inheritance arrow iota_*: A_parent -> A_F  [ANCHOR-1, input layer; canonical_constants.py w0_FW = -0.918 provenance]
    Definition 3: C1 = Connes 1996 reconstruction + NCG axioms 3 (orientability/Hochschild cycle) + 5 (first-order [[D,a],b^o]=0) + 6 (real structure J) + Schur orthogonality of irreducible A_F-modules  [ANCHOR-2, output layer]

    Substitute:  apply C1 to a FREELY-CHOSEN A_F (without V1):

    Simplify:    only the sequential composition V1 -> A_F -> C1 fixes BOTH (which A_F) AND (the unique B1/B2 partition).
                 Schur orthogonality of irreducible A_F-modules: P_{B1} . P_{B2} = 0 => NO free unitary mixing parameter => binary (two discrete cells), not continuous.
    Canonical form: conclusion = ( fixed A_F via V1 ) AND ( unique P_{B1}(+)P_{B2} via C1 ), with P_{B1}.P_{B2}=0.
    Direction:   neither anchor reproduces the conclusion via an independent parallel route (PRIMARY+CONFIRMATION would require that); the dependency is SEQUENTIAL and non-fungible => SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY is the correct anchor structure (per registry-landing.md §"When PRIMARY+CONFIRMATION is wrong"); binary-not-continuous follows from P_{B1}.P_{B2}=0.
    Conclusion:  the multi-valued classification is binary (2 cells) and CO-PRIMARY-anchored; each reviewer re-derives this from first principles on its own axis (axis-A: NCG-axiomatic Schur/first-order; axis-B: spectral-block separation of D_K^2 clusters).

# ---- JOINT-clause PASS-AND logic (per joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2") ----
# §VII.AC.1 is a JOINT cross-axis theorem (substrate-inheritance axis V1 + NCG-axiomatic axis C1). Clause partition:
#   JOINT clauses (require PASS in BOTH reviewer verdicts):
#     (joint-1) SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY structure is correct: V1 and C1 are sequential + non-fungible; neither alone fixes the conclusion (NOT PRIMARY+CONFIRMATION). [registry-landing.md §"Detection" criteria 1-4, INCLUDING criterion 4: both anchors on the SAME algebra-axis cell — Corner III]
#     (joint-2) binary-not-continuous: Schur orthogonality P_{B1}.P_{B2}=0 forces a 2-cell (not continuous) partition under NCG axioms 3+5+6.
#   single-axis-A clauses (reviewer-A = van-den-dungen, NCG-axiomatic, PASS in A only):
#     (a-1) C1 output layer: Connes-1996 reconstruction + axioms 3+5+6 yield the UNIQUE B1/B2 block decomposition of D^2 at the irrep level once A_F is fixed (Wedderburn enumeration + KO-dim-6 grading gamma_P).
#     (a-2) Corner III (DEPENDENT x s=3) algebra-axis classification correctness per §VII.U.2 clause (e).
#   single-axis-B clauses (reviewer-B = kitaev, spectral-block separation, PASS in B only):
#     (b-1) V1 input layer: the BDI 0D inheritance arrow forces A_F as the smallest finite spectral algebra consistent with BDI 0D + finite-spectrum sub-axis; B1/B2 are the longitudinal-acoustic / transverse-fiber eigenvalue CLUSTERS of D_K^2 at tau_fold (the spectral-separation reading).
#     (b-2) Path-H = projection onto B1 cluster; Path-C = projection onto B2 cluster; r-projection per pathway is well-defined.
# PASS = (a-1 AND a-2 PASS in A) AND (b-1 AND b-2 PASS in B) AND (joint-1 PASS in A AND PASS in B) AND (joint-2 PASS in A AND PASS in B).

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Both reviewers PASS their single-axis clauses AND every JOINT clause PASSes in BOTH verdicts (logical AND).
  => §VII.AC.1 promoted STAGE-1-CANDIDATE -> STAGE-3-PERMANENT. atlas-04 K2 + atlas-07 §VII.AC.1 + open-channel-ledger §C K2 + registry §VII.AC.1 Status all flip to STAGE-3-PERMANENT (registry tag-flip executed by mack-cosmic-bridge IF the entry carries a §7-falsifier-surface touch; otherwise orchestrator-direct — §VII.AC.1 is a structural NCG landing, mack N/A; the orchestrator flips the four register surfaces). Solution-space: the Path-H/Path-C dual-pathway structure is now a blind-verified permanent anchor; downstream r-discriminator citations (LiteBIRD n_T 4.250sigma Path-H/Path-C) inherit permanent status.
FAIL_meaning: >
  ANY clause FAILs in EITHER reviewer verdict. => Stage-2 -> Stage-3 promotion BLOCKED; §VII.AC.1 stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause routes to S108 remediation. Solution-space: the FAIL localizes WHICH axis (substrate-inheritance V1 vs NCG-axiomatic C1) or WHICH joint clause (CO-PRIMARY structure vs binary-not-continuous) the registered text does not survive blind first-principles re-derivation. NOT an agent failure — a constraint-map update naming the unsupported clause.
INFO_meaning: >
  ANY clause returns INFO in EITHER reviewer verdict (and no clause FAILs). => theorem stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the INFO clause documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item with its forward gate. Canonical INFO trap for this slot family: the S88 W-27 (volovik x connes) workshop surfaced an Element-2 OE-form INFO on a sibling (§VII.X.W4-1 q=II Mellin-residue); if a reviewer raises an analogous registry-text-form INFO here (e.g. anchor-provenance SHA availability, OE-form of the r-projection), it is Stage-2-INFO-deferred, NOT a FAIL.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:

  estimated_time: "0.5 wave (2-agent parallel dispatch + PASS-AND closeout)"

  observable: the regulator-class lattice's two-cell decomposition of the SAME fiber spectrum at tau_fold.
  Direction of explanation flows substrate -> bridge -> laboratory: D_K eigenvalues at tau_fold ->

  fiber A_F = C(+)H(+)M_3(C). Treating Path-H/Path-C as "two phenomenological choices" inverts the
  direction and is a container-thinking violation per phononic-framing.md.

# Per-channel independence: each k in {1,2,3} must independently satisfy (joint-c(k) AND joint-d(k)) PASS-AND.

  PASS in landau + joint-c(k) PASS in BOTH + joint-d(k) PASS in BOTH. => §VII.X.W4-1 promoted

# ---- JOINT-clause PASS-AND logic ----
# §VII.AC.4 is a JOINT cross-axis meta-theorem (substrate-inheritance V1 axis + NCG-axiomatic C1 axis) that
# CALIBRATES the SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY structure. Clause partition (registered 6-step chain +
# anchor-structure argument):
#   JOINT clauses (PASS-AND in BOTH verdicts):
#     (joint-1) SEQUENTIAL dependency: C1 cannot be invoked without first invoking V1 (C1-alone on a free A_F
#               is tautological). Both axes must confirm.
#     (joint-2) NON-FUNGIBLE: V1 and C1 cannot be swapped or reordered without breaking the chain; both must
#               remain accessible. Both axes must confirm.
#     (joint-3) anchor-structure correctness: SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY (not PRIMARY+CONFIRMATION), AND
#               both anchors on the SAME algebra-axis cell (Corner III) per registry-landing.md §"Detection"
#               criterion 4 + cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Algebra-axis orthogonality K-counter". Both
#               axes must confirm (cross-corner CO-PRIMARY is STRUCTURALLY FORBIDDEN — the reviewers verify
#               V1-side and C1-side are NOT on orthogonal algebra-axis cells).
#   single-axis-A clauses (reviewer-A = van-den-dungen, NCG-axiomatic):
#     (a-1) C1 output layer: axioms 3+5+6 + Schur orthogonality yield the UNIQUE B1/B2 block decomposition of
#           D^2 at the irrep level (6-step chain steps 4-5: [D,P_alpha]=0 via Hochschild-cycle + first-order;
#           P_{B1}.P_{B2}=0 via Schur).
#     (a-2) Wedderburn enumeration + KO-dim-6 grading (step 2-3): A_F has exactly 3 irreps (chi_C, chi_H,
#           chi_3); the 96-dim H_F is conjugate-doubled, parity-graded into B1 (+) B2.
#   single-axis-B clauses (reviewer-B = kitaev, spectral-block separation):
#     (b-1) V1 input layer (step 1): the BDI 0D inheritance arrow forces A_F = smallest finite spectral
#           algebra consistent with BDI class; B1/B2 are the D_K^2 eigenvalue clusters at tau_fold.
#     (b-2) r-projection (step 6): each pathway r_alpha = <P_alpha . D^2 . P_alpha>_{a_4^zeta} is a
#           block-restricted variational derivative of the SAME a_4^zeta moment; Path-H = r_{B1}, Path-C = r_{B2}.
# PASS = (a-1 AND a-2 PASS in A) AND (b-1 AND b-2 PASS in B) AND (joint-1 AND joint-2 AND joint-3 PASS in BOTH).

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Both reviewers PASS their single-axis clauses AND all 3 JOINT clauses (sequential, non-fungible,
  CO-PRIMARY-same-axis-cell) PASS in BOTH verdicts. => §VII.AC.4 promoted STAGE-1-CANDIDATE ->
  STAGE-3-PERMANENT; the registry §VII.AC.4 "LANDED" status flips to STAGE-3-PERMANENT-VERIFIED + atlas-04
  K11 + open-channel-ledger §C K11 flip (orchestrator-direct; structural NCG landing, mack N/A). ALSO resolves

  tag it Stage-2-pending — a PASS reconciles BOTH to STAGE-3-PERMANENT (the atlas-07 "PERMANENT" was a
  premature tag predating the Stage-2 verify; this gate supplies the missing Stage-2 PASS-AND). Solution-space:
  the SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY sequential-chain calibration is blind-verified — the registry-landing.md
  calibration-corpus instance is now Stage-2-grounded.
FAIL_meaning: >
  ANY clause FAILs in EITHER verdict. => promotion BLOCKED; §VII.AC.4 stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE (down-correcting
  the premature atlas-07 "PERMANENT" tag to STAGE-1-CANDIDATE, reconciled to the ledger Stage-2-pending);
  FAILing clause routes to S108. Most-at-risk: joint-3 (anchor-structure correctness) — if a reviewer reads
  V1 and C1 as INDEPENDENT parallel routes (PRIMARY+CONFIRMATION) rather than SEQUENTIAL, the CO-PRIMARY
  calibration FAILs; OR if the two anchors are found to live on DIFFERENT algebra-axis cells (cross-corner
  CO-PRIMARY, structurally forbidden), joint-3 FAILs. Solution-space: localizes whether the sequential
  dependency, non-fungibility, or same-axis-cell requirement does not survive blind re-derivation.
INFO_meaning: >
  ANY clause returns INFO in EITHER verdict (no clause FAILs). => stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; INFO documented as
  Stage-2-INFO-deferred. Possible INFO locus: the Corner-III algebra-axis classification (the registered entry
  carries an S88 §W5b-46 audit-SUBSTITUTED annotation — "Mellin pole inferred from a_4^zeta semantic marker
  per §VII.U.2 clause (e) consultation per S88 audit FAIL on lexical-marker absence"); a reviewer MAY return

| **W2-2 S107-VIIXW41** (K7) | §VII.X.W4-1 → STAGE-3-PERMANENT (3rd blind-verified cross-pillar bridge); flip K7 surfaces | stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; FAILing (clause,channel) → S108 | stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; pre-registered INFO = q=II Element-2 OE-form (W7a-75 retrofit forward path) |
| **W2-3 S107-VIIX2NEC** (K9) | structural necessity blind-verified; → STAGE-3-PERMANENT CONTINGENT on the anchor-availability remediation (S46/S64/S65/S77+C9 SHA harvest); if SHA harvest incomplete → PASS-ON-STRUCTURE + S108 anchor-emission CF | stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; FAILing clause (likely joint-2 asymmetry) → S108 | stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; pre-registered INFO = structural-PASS-but-registry-PASS-criterion-unmet (6/6 anchor SHA) |
| **W2-4 S107-VIIAC4** (K11) | §VII.AC.4 → STAGE-3-PERMANENT; reconcile atlas-07 "PERMANENT" ↔ ledger Stage-2-pending drift to STAGE-3-PERMANENT-VERIFIED | down-correct atlas-07 premature "PERMANENT" → STAGE-1-CANDIDATE (reconciled to ledger); FAILing clause → S108 | stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; possible INFO = Corner-III audit-substituted annotation (parse-tree-expansion forward path) |

**Wave-AND closeout**: this is a parallel-compute-wave (Q3) — there is NO wave-level AND across the four gates. Each gate's PASS-AND is internal (the two reviewers per gate). The four gates land four independent verdict lines; the session-close synthesis reports four individual gate positions (NOT a "4/4 PASS ratio" — per `feedback_reporting-framing.md`, no session-aggregate metric).

**Registry-drift flag (resolve at plan-freeze / session-close)**: atlas-07-permanent-results tags **§VII.AC.4 "PERMANENT"** and **§VII.X.2-NECESSITY "PERMANENT"** (the latter with a "down-corrected from unsupported PERMANENT 2026-06-1…" note), while atlas-04 §X / open-channel-ledger §C tag BOTH as **Stage-2 pending**. This is a registry-vs-atlas status drift. The Stage-2 verifies in this wave are the canonical resolver: a PASS reconciles to STAGE-3-PERMANENT (the atlas-07 tag was premature-but-vindicated); a FAIL/INFO reconciles atlas-07 DOWN to STAGE-1-CANDIDATE (matching the ledger). Either way the four register surfaces (atlas-04, atlas-07, ledger §C, registry status) are reconciled at session-close per the capstone-hygiene Q3 discipline.

## Wave 2 Audit-at-Plan-Freeze Checklist (`_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py` 6-item)

Per `.claude/rules/joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Audit at plan-freeze"`, each of the four gate blocks satisfies all 6 items:

1. **Two cross-reviewers dispatched IN PARALLEL** (not sequentially) — each gate block's `method.description` + `machinery_pin_map.blind_dispatch` specify parallel dispatch by gen-physicist (single message, two Agent calls). ✓
2. **Cross-reviewers on DIFFERENT axes** — W2-1: van-den-dungen [NCG] × kitaev [quantum-chaos]; W2-2: van-den-dungen [NCG] × landau [condensed-matter]; W2-3: van-den-dungen [NCG] × volovik [substrate]; W2-4: van-den-dungen [NCG] × kitaev [quantum-chaos]. Each pair is axis-distinct (Axis-A NCG/spectral vs Axis-B chaos/condensed-matter/substrate). ✓
3. **Cross-reviewers NOT the original workshop authoring agents** (with downstream-inheritance reach) — each gate's `stage0_authorship_EXCLUDED` states the registered Stage-0 authorship lines + the inheritance-reach exclusions (K2: lizzi/transit + volovik; K7: connes/lizzi + volovik; K9: connes + lizzi; K11: volovik/connes + lizzi). None of the chosen reviewers (van-den-dungen, kitaev, landau, volovik-on-K9-only) is a Stage-0 author or inheritance-successor of the theorem it reviews. ✓
4. **Dispatch prompts do NOT include the workshop transcripts** — each gate's `blind_dispatch` field pins: reviewers receive ONLY the registered Stage-1 entry text + slot input files; the named originating workshop transcript is withheld. ✓
5. **JOINT clauses PASS-AND'd across both verdicts in the gate logic** — each gate's JOINT-clause PASS-AND block enumerates the JOINT clauses + the logical-AND aggregation (W2-2 with per-channel independence). ✓
6. **Cross-reviewer's audit machinery NOT structurally self-authored** — the verdict-aggregation machinery (the PASS-AND logic) is authored by gen-physicist (the dispatch owner), NOT by either cross-reviewer; each reviewer emits a clause-verdict JSON, and gen-physicist's producing script recomputes the AND deterministically. No reviewer applies its own self-authored decision procedure at the verdict-emission layer. (SUGGESTION-status item at K=1; satisfied by construction here — the aggregation author is disjoint from both reviewers.) ✓

**Per-gate-distinct audit_sha256**: even though van-den-dungen reviews all four and kitaev reviews two, each gate's `audit_sha256` input map embeds the per-gate `gate_id` + the per-gate registered-entry SHA + the per-gate reviewer-verdict-JSON SHAs, so the four `audit_sha256` values are pairwise distinct (sig_5 ladder uniqueness preserved per `.claude/rules/v3-closure-recovery.md` + `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` §"per-gate-distinct audit_sha256").
